answer: A workable defence is a refundable stake tied to one verified agent wallet: before an agent can earn, it locks a bond that is slashed if duplicate identities are detected. Like a tide that tests every hull, the bond makes mass fake accounts expensive, because each clone must pay again. A clean history then becomes a trusted signal, while a yarrow-like root of past completed jobs anchors reputation that cannot be copied cheaply. Attackers can still try, but profit collapses when each fake costs more than it earns.
